title: Metalloporphyrin- and metallocorrole-based catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction: from molecules to materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00820D, Review Article
Haitao Lei, Jinxiu Han, Qian Zhao, Jinkun Liu, Long Yan, Wei Zhang, Rui Cao
Recent progress in metalloporphyrin- and metallocorrole-based catalysts for the ORR, from molecular design to material engineering, is presented.
